name: Iron crypt gate
description: A crypt gate 1.6 m wide and about 2.4 m high: a round-arched doorway of grey dressed stone with a raised keystone, closed by an iron grille door of vertical bars and two cross bands whose spear-point tips rise under the arch, hung on heavy strap hinges and locked with a large padlock on a hasp.

provenance.prompt: A crypt gate about 2.4 m high and 1.6 m wide: a round-arched stone doorway frame with an iron grille door of vertical bars, two cross bands, spear-point tips under the arch, heavy hinges and a large padlock on a hasp.
